scope: Structural verification only — no generator was executed. For each of the 23 generators cataloged in audit/generator-dependencies-v2.json (Phase 2A), checks whether its documented dataset reads are satisfied by the datasets lib/adapters/legacy-datasets.js actually exposes today (names, namesEnriched, popularity, categories, variants — verified concretely in audit/adapter-validation.json, not asserted).
adapterCoveredCollectionsNote: This adapter layer covers only the datasets explicitly named in the Phase 3B brief's Part 2 examples plus categories.json (needed by nearly every consumer alongside them). data/name-equivalents.json, data/last-names.json, data/heraldry.json, data/compatibility_patterns.json, data/country-differentials.json, data/regional-trend-acceleration.json, data/countries.json, and build/topic-clusters.json have no adapter in this phase — generators needing them are reported as partially-satisfied or not-applicable below, not silently assumed compatible.

roleDefinitions.page-generator: Reads datasets to render pages — the adapter's intended consumer.
roleDefinitions.data-builder: Produces a dataset from raw/curated sources — a WRITE-side role. The read-through adapter tested here answers a different question (can reads be redirected) than what a producer needs (a canonical WRITE path, out of scope for Phase 3B).
roleDefinitions.computation-engine: A pure scoring function taking already-loaded values as parameters, with no direct dataset reads of its own.

keyFinding: Restricting the view to the 11 true page-generators (the adapter's intended consumers), 8 are fully-satisfied and 3 are partially-satisfied by this phase's adapter coverage — none are unsupported outright. The 10 'not-applicable' data-builders are not a coverage gap: they are producers, and a read-through adapter is structurally the wrong tool to evaluate them (a future phase would need a canonical WRITE path, a different question). Excluding those correctly out-of-scope generators, adapter coverage among relevant consumers is 8/11 fully-satisfied (73%), all without a single line of generator code changed.
